description: Defines the interface for a channel equalizer class used in radio signal processing, including nested class for channel estimates and a method for equalization.

classes.name: channel_equalizer
classes.description: Interface for a channel equalizer that mitigates radio channel effects and reverts layer mapping.

classes.name: ch_est_list
classes.description: Nested class providing access to channel estimation data.

methods.name: is_supported
methods.description: Checks if the given number of ports and layers are supported by the equalizer.

methods.name: equalize
methods.description: Performs MIMO channel equalization and combines transmit-receive paths, estimating symbols and noise variances.
